description: Genuine consumer pilots. Read-only: the consumer repository is checked out at a pinned commit in CI, a dev-platform.toml is generated and committed only inside that throwaway checkout; nothing is pushed and no consumer is migrated. The release under test is the one named here, installed with the trusted installer under pins taken from releases/<version>/identity.json.
_findings: F1 (fixed in head): published 0.1.2 `init` proposed python.unittest for a Rust workspace with an incidental .py file.
F2: flight's locked dependencies require rustc >= 1.88; the shipped rust-cargo profile pins 1.85.0. Resolved by the new rust-cargo-1.99 profile (a toolchain change is a new release).

F3: on macOS the consumer's create_session_tui_e2e test times out (it drives a terminal/tmux); the platform has no declared host-tool requirements, so this environment dependency is outside the evidence (issue filed).
